residualGaps: (1) vcpkg: LMMS vcpkg.json at the tag has no builtin-baseline/overrides and there is no vcpkg-configuration.json, so versions follow the runner's VCPKG_ROOT ports tree at the time build/vcpkg_installed was cached (CI cache key = hash(vcpkg.json); vcpkg.json last changed 2026-04-01, #8218). The September runner's vcpkg (30ef65cad9) has DIFFERENT versions (fluidsynth 2.5.7, opus 1.6.1, fftw 3.3.11), so the release used the cached April install. The vcpkg commit b5d1a94fb7 (image ubuntu24/20260329.72) is inferred: every embedded version string (libsndfile 1.2.2, libFLAC 1.5.0, libVorbis 1.3.7, opus 1.5.2, mpg123 1.33.4, LAME 3.100, fftw 3.3.10, libsamplerate 0.2.2, SDL 2.32.10, fluidsynth 2.5.2 path, PortAudio V19.7, zlib 1.3.1) matches it, and all 22 ports have identical version#port-version in vcpkg 751fdf7bbc (03-09), 596c7b12a7, b5d1a94fb7 and 14de8214a1 (04-06). Upstream versions are exact. The exact vcpkg commit, and so the port patch set, is near-certain but not proven from a log (the Actions logs need auth). (2) Versions of serd, sord, zix, lilv, lv2, sratom, ogg, libstk and fltk are not embedded as strings. They come from the same baseline, with symbols present (sratom symbols were not found; it is listed as a lilv dependency anyway). (3) fltk's vcpkg dependencies (libpng, libjpeg-turbo, freetype, fontconfig, expat, and others) were installed but none of their symbols appear in RemoteZynAddSubFx.exe, so they are not listed. (4) Not compiled or shipped, so not listed: Carla (only its headers are used; the shipped libcarla_native-plugin.dll is LMMS's DummyCarla stub), its nested submodule Carla-Plugins 3c0026da, zynaddsubfx nested submodule 'instruments' c5c91213 (the data/presets come from the LMMS tree), qt5-x11embed 499d737c, doc/wiki, and libjpeg-turbo-mingw-w64 (no qjpeg plugin shipped). (5) GitHub/GitLab archive URLs use tags for vcpkg ports. The content is pinned by the vcpkg portfile SHA512 (prefix in evidence), but codeload tarball bytes can differ in compression from the vcpkg-cached file. The submodule archives are by commit SHA. (6) The bytes of gcc-13 orig (about 90 MB) and Qt orig (50 MB) come from HEAD/Content-Length; nothing over 20 MB was downloaded. (7) Licence notes: lmms.exe links GPL-3.0 ringbuffer and fftw (GPL-2.0+), so the effective licence of lmms.exe is GPL-3.0. The NSIS stub is a separate program under Zlib/bzip2/CPL-1.0.
